profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at SmartBuild Systems
profile.summary:
I am a developer with a passion for creating engineering software. I have a wide range of experience ranging from desktop-based hydraulics and hydrology modeling software to embedded robotics projects targeted towards space exploration.

Specialties: Programming, C, C++, C#, Java, Visual Basic .NET,  XML, Microsoft .NET Framework, Subversion (svn), Mercurial (hg), Git, WPF

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: SmartBuild Systems is the pole barn industry's only complete design system for post frame structures. I built SmartBuild from the ground up and continue to provide full stack software development services ranging from web-based user interface design, to 3D geometric calculations, to database and server administration .
positions.insights: Skills: C# · 3D Math · Server Administration · JavaScript · ASP.NET · Software Design

positions.title: Software Development Contractor
positions.description: Keymark provides 3D Modeling Software for the Construction Industry. I work on several different projects including an application to generate SketchUp and OBJ/MTL files from legacy data, and an application for designing tiny homes.

positions.title: Lead Developer
positions.description:
Tacuna Development is a division of Tacuna Systems, a small Colorado based-company specializing in tools for sensing, data acquisition, and controls. Our mission at Tacuna Development is to provide custom hardware and software solutions to end users. We can provide full-stack solutions, all the way from circuit conceptualization to desktop-based control software, to mobile application for your phone or tablet. 

Let us jump-start your project: Head on over to http://tacunadevelopment.com to check us out!

positions.title: Software Development Contractor
positions.description: authentiQ is a company that aims to personalize the user's shopping experience by maximizing offline to online conversions (barcode scanning, image recognition, location). I was a full stack developer responsible for developing and maintaining a MySQL database, PHP server code, an Android application, and a javascript web application.

positions.title: Software Development Contractor
positions.description: Fantasy Empire is a new daily fantasy sports website dedicated to improving the daily fantasy experience for the average user by giving them the tools they need to compete. I worked as a back-end software development contractor using groovy on grails.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I lead a small development team creating C++ and C# software for Simpson's Component Solutions offering.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Keymark provides 3D Modeling Software for the Construction Industry- I work as part of team to develop software solutions in C++ and C#.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Responsible for developing hydraulics and hydrology software, and other software as required, using VBA, Visual Basic .NET, and C.

company.name: Urban Drainage and Flood Control District

positions.title: Software Development Contractor
positions.description: Responsible for developing WQCOSM, a C++ based rainfall analysis program based on legacy software.

projects.title: Tacuna Systems WifiDAQ
projects.description:
- Worked as part of a team to develop a low-cost data acquisition board
- Developed a C library for the PIC microcontroller to allow firmware to transparently communicate with RS-232, USB (CDC), Ethernet, and wireless (802.11) connections
- Worked with hardware developers to quickly integrate with new hardware revisions

projects.title: Lunar Applied Science and Engineering Rover
projects.description:
- Worked as part of a multi-disciplinary team in the mechanical design, construction and testing of prototype lunar excavation hardware.
- Assisted in the development and presentation of a business plan for the 2007 Lunar Ventures Business Proposal Competition.
- Lead programmer responsible for developing systems for both autonomous and remote operation of the rover for NASA's 2008 and 2009 Regolith Excavation Challenges.
- Gave presentations to media representatives, sponsors, advisors and student groups.
- Developed open-source hardware for use by future teams (http://sourceforge.net/projects/lpc2468-utils/).
